newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-SOUTHAMPTON TO BE SOLD FOR $16.5 MLN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SOUTHAMPTON TO BE SOLD FOR $16.5 MLN.

text.p: Struggling English premier league club Southampton is to be sold for 10 million pounds ($16.5 million).
The club, which plans to move from the Dell stadium to a new ground in the north of the south coast city, has agreed a deal with British residential property company Secure Retirement.
Southampton are currently third from bottom in the premier league with 13 points from 17 games.
